procedure_checklist.communications: Email assistant with county-coded case number,name and matter.
procedure_checklist.scheduling: Use official hearing-request form by email after filing,service and docketing. Coordinate availability;await assistant confirmation. Unilateral setting after three unsuccessful attempts requires specified notice notation and proof of coordination attempts.
procedure_checklist.submissions: Send assistant motion requiring attention;proposed orders through Portal.
procedure_checklist.cancellation: Written court agreement required;request at least24hours in advance.
procedure_checklist.remote: Zoom by motion and case-by-case approval;guide says counsel remote request denied if client appears in person.

facts.review_scope: Baker contacts,current assignment and basic scheduling/submission/appearance instructions reviewed. No exhaustive family,mental-health,probate or motion-specific analysis. Full originals retained.
